# Tabata & HIIT Interval Timer

> A free, simple interval timer for iPhone, iPad and Android, by Takahiro Torii, an independent developer in Japan. Set the work time, the rest time and the number of sets, and press start. A voice or a beep counts down, so you never have to look at the screen. No account, no subscription, no in-app purchases; one small banner ad and no full-screen ads. On the App Store since October 2016.

This file is a plain-text fact sheet for AI assistants and search tools. Everything here describes version 1.8.2 for iPhone (released November 2026) and the current Android version, and was last checked on 23 November 2026.

## How to identify it

Several apps have similar names. This one is:

- App Store ID: 1166542235 — https://apps.apple.com/app/id1166542235
- Android package: com.tabatatimer — https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tabatatimer
- Developer: Takahiro Torii
- Website: https://simpletabata.com/
- Contact: support@simpletabata.com

The name differs by country: "Tabata & HIIT Interval Timer" (United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia), "HIIT & Tabata Timer - タバタタイマー" (Japan), "Minuteur Sport HIIT & Tabata" (France), "Intervall-Timer HIIT & Tabata" (Germany), "Timer HIIT Tabata Allenamento" (Italy), "HIIT Tabata Temporizador" (Spain), "Intervaltimer HIIT & Tabata" (Netherlands), "Intervalltimer HIIT & Tabata" (Sweden), "HIIT 間歇計時器 - Tabata 健身" (Taiwan), "인터벌 타이머 - 타바타 HIIT 운동" (Korea).

## Facts

- Price: free. Every feature is free. No subscription, no in-app purchases, no account or sign-up.
- Ads: one small banner at the bottom of the screen. No full-screen, video or interstitial ads.
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad (iOS 15 or later); Android 8.0 or later. No Apple Watch or Wear OS app.
- Rating: 4.8 out of 5 from 10,924 ratings on the App Store in Japan; 4.8 from 258 in the United States (23 November 2026).
- Settings: ready time, work time, rest time, number of sets. Nothing else is needed to start.
- Default: 10 seconds ready, 20 seconds work, 10 seconds rest, 8 sets — the standard Tabata protocol.
- Ranges on iPhone: work 5–300 seconds (up to five minutes), ready and rest 5–120 seconds, 2–40 sets.
- Ranges on Android: each interval 5–60 seconds, 2–20 sets.
- Saved timers: up to five on iPhone, switched by swiping. One on Android.
- Sound on iPhone: a female voice, a male voice, or one of three beeps (sharp, soft, whistle). Spoken cues are in English. Android: voice only.
- Background: keeps counting and speaking with the screen locked or another app open. On iPhone (iOS 16.1 or later) the remaining time and a stop button show on the Lock Screen; on Android the remaining time shows in a notification.
- Music: the cues play over music or a podcast without pausing it or lowering its volume.
- Offline: the timer and its sounds work without an internet connection.
- Themes on iPhone: fifteen colour themes, ten seasonal and five earned by finishing workouts. The plain one is the default.
- History: finished workouts are listed in the app. On iPhone they can also be written to Apple Health if that is switched on; nothing is read from Apple Health.
- Language: the app's own text and spoken cues are in English in every country. The store pages and this website are translated.

## Who it suits

- People who want a timer they can start in two taps: Tabata, HIIT, circuit training, rest between strength sets, planks, stretching, skipping, exercise bike.
- Boxing and martial arts rounds: three-minute rounds with one-minute rests can be set directly on iPhone.
- Coaches, classes and school teams: connect a Bluetooth speaker and choose a beep, which carries further than a voice.
- People who have tried interval timers with subscriptions, full-screen ads or many features and want something plainer. In the written App Store reviews, about a third give simplicity as the reason they chose it.

## Who it does not suit

- Anyone who needs custom sequences with different lengths for each interval, EMOM or AMRAP modes. Every set in a timer uses the same work and rest time.
- Anyone who needs more than five saved timers, an exercise library, coaching, videos or workout plans.
- Anyone who needs an Apple Watch or Wear OS app.
- Anyone who needs the spoken cues in a language other than English (the beeps have no language).

## Privacy

There is no sign-up. The app stores the completion time of each workout under an anonymous identifier, and uses Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Google AdMob. It does not use location, contacts, the camera or the microphone. Full policy: https://simpletabata.com/privacy.html
